content.text: Triiiceratops ships a small set of vanilla-CSS design tokens. There are three ways to style the viewer, from easiest to most granular:
These aren't exclusive tiers you have to climb in order — you can override just one piece of a built-in theme (e.g. tweak
's other tokens as-is), or skip built-in themes entirely and build a fully custom theme from scratch by setting the CSS variables yourself.
styling surface. The viewer's shadow-DOM internals are not reachable from the outside: there is no
surface, no way to inject a consumer stylesheet into the shadow root, and no light-DOM styling hook for internal elements. Everything about the
element — layout, size, borders, and any CSS that treats it as a box in your page — is yours as usual.
